# OWL

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Web Ontology Language - a W3C standard for authoring ontologies with formal, machine-processable semantics for classes, properties, and logical relationships.

## Scope note

The target language for the eventual Ontology stage (e.g. via Protege), building on the SKOS taxonomy.

## Broader

- [W3C Standard](../W3CStandard/) — generic (ISO 25964)
